Datasets are deliberately small: deterministic excerpts, synthetic generators, and torchvision downloads sized for laptops. The catalog below is generated from [`datasets.yaml`](https://github.com/harvard-edge/cs249r_book/blob/main/mlperf-edu/datasets.yaml).

Fetch and inspect assets with:

```bash
mlperf fetch --profile max --dry-run   # show what would be downloaded
mlperf info --dataset tinyshakespeare  # one dataset's dossier
mlperf cache list                      # inspect the local cache
```
